answer: Proof of stake remains a robust Sybil resistance mechanism, requiring agents to commit assets into a vault to earn validation rights. Much like a reef structure protects a coastline, staked capital serves as a defense against malicious nodes. Attackers who attempt to forge identities face the timber of their own burned tokens; the cost of acquiring sufficient stake to influence the consensus exceeds any potential gains, effectively rendering large-scale identity fabrication economically irrational.
